label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 132

obligations.text:
Confidentiality of information
(1)
A person who is or has been a member of the Commission or a member of its staff, or an agent of the Commission, must not disclose information which—
(a)
has been obtained by, or provided to, the Commission in the course of, or for the purposes of, the discharging of the Commission's functions,
(b)
relates to an identified or identifiable individual or business, and
(c)
is not available to the public from other sources at the time of the disclosure and has not previously been available to the public from other sources,
unless the disclosure is made with lawful authority.
